title: Registering a channel of the type system, reserved to the framework's own records, is refused, and nothing of it is registered
notes: The transport and the intelligence channel of type system are refused with invalid_argument, and no channel_registered is emitted; the same id registers once it names another type. The part of RK-6.2-011 left unobserved: only a host channel claims host (§10.5); a scripted channel of type host is the runner's host channel, so no step registers another channel of that type. Python: core/mixins/channel_ops.py register_channel; roomkit-rs: roomkit-core rules/host.rs claims_reserved_type.
